about: Each game the mashup reads. Role follows Melty's recipe: primary = host Melty installs into, secondary = found by the mod itself.

rows.name: Deadlock
rows.locate: launch arg --deadlock "{game}" from Melty; fallback: Steam libraryfolders.vdf + appmanifest_1422450.acf
rows.missing_message: Deadlock wasn't found. Only Bebop reads Bebop and the hero roster from your Deadlock install - install it on Steam, then press Play again.
rows.source: Melty game_info (exe game/bin/win64/deadlock.exe); SteamDB GameTracking-Deadlock pak01_dir layout

rows.name: Only Up!
rows.locate: Steam libraryfolders.vdf -> appmanifest_2381590.acf installdir; fallback: steamapps/common/* containing *-Win64-Shipping.exe and Content/Paks with 'Only' in folder name
rows.missing_message: Only Up! wasn't found. The climb is Only Up!'s own level, read from your copy - install Only Up! from your Steam library (it was delisted in 2023, so only existing owners have it), then press Play again.
rows.source: SteamSpy app 2381590; Wikipedia (Unreal Engine 5, removed from Steam Sept 2023); UE uses centimetres
